svg.title: branch point animation
svg.text: one split of x ∈ [0, 4]: where to cut? (f* = -0.381; children use their own αBB)
split point: the relaxation minimizer puts the cut where the bound is decided (one example)
1 · bound the box: the minimizer of the convex underestimator (red) estimates where f is small
2 · cut at the midpoint, or at p = clip(0.75·x_relax + 0.25·mid, lo + 0.2w, hi − 0.2w)
3 · each child is relaxed on its own: cutting near the minimizer tightens the bound there
